name: Elite Senior Secondary School
description: About Us The Elite Senior Secondary School was conceived as a major educational initiative in 1996, adopting a mission to establish a truly exceptional Educational Institution in Kheda Dist, Gujarat. Elite Senior Secondary School is the Fourth such endeavour of SHREE GANESH EDUCATION TRUST which was established in 1983. Located on the Kheda-Dholka Highway, in proximity to Kheda Town, Nadiad Town and Ahmedabad City, the School exists as an oasis of academic and sporting excellence. Situated amidst a picturesque green environment, close to the nature, the students breathe and study in a pollution free clean air, away from the bustling city crowd and traffic snarls. Students (boys) in grades 1 and above have the option of hostel accommodation on campus. Students are housed in comfortable rooms and provided with wholesome nutritional food with a pre-defined menu. A fleet of School buses transport day students to and from school. We welcome local students, out-of-state students and students from Indian families residing overseas. The School follows Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board Curriculum upto Standard VIII and CBSE Curriculum from Standard IX onwards. The teaching faculty has been recruited from the finest practitioners. Teaching styles reflect the best education practice, with students being taught how to analyse, think creatively and solve problems. This helps the students learn how to manage their time effectively, work independently and develop excellent academic profiles. We also provide appropriate additional support for students who require it, whether this be to raise attainment in areas of weakness or stretch the most gifted. Towards the end of a student’s schooling the School will provide counselling when the time comes to apply to universities at home or overseas. The principal aim of the institution is thus to provide world-class academic and sporting instruction and to educate the next generation of leaders, athletes and entrepreneurs.

name: SGVP International School
description: About Us In ancient India, Gurukuls were the centres for learning. The teachers at Gurukuls were the great masters called Rishis. Students lived with the masters. They learned the principles, not by memorizing, but by applying them in real life. The focus of educational system was on development of practical wisdom rather than on accumulation of information. The curriculum integrated moral values. It was this unique way of teaching that made the students achieve success in both the material and spiritual spheres of life. Inspired by this ancient system of education, in May 1948, the visionary H. H. Shastriji Maharaj Shree Dharmjivandasji Swami laid the foundation of the first Gurukul in Rajkot. Gradually, his great vision manifested into reality in form of other branches at Junagadh, Ahmedabad, Surat and Hyderabad. These institutions have became educational centre of repute in India. Heartened by the success of re-living the ancient system, the disciple saints of Shastriji Maharaj expanded the horizons by envisioning a modern Gurukul at Chharodi to be a centre of Academic Excellence at international level which would combine Science, Sports and Spirituality. Thus was born the Swaminarayan Gurukul Vishwavidya Pratishthanam (SGVP) at Chharodi with blessings of H.H. Pujya Shree Jogi Swami. SGVP is located in the outskirts of Ahmedabad on a 52 acre campus with all modern facilities, offering education in English medium from Junior KG to class XII. With the blessings Shastri Shree Madhavpriyadasji Swami and expert guidance of Purani Balkrishnadasji Swami, SGVP continues to attain height of success in academic sphere. There are many people whose contribution, in bringing SGVP at the point where it stands now, can never be forgotten. Their keen interest and persistent efforts in shaping a better world for the future generations at SGVP must be acknowledged.

description: About Us Our journey as an educational institution has been nothing short of remarkable. With a legacy deeply rooted in fostering knowledge, nurturing talents, and shaping futures, we have consistently strived for excellence in education. The Genius Group of Institutions will continue to be a place where students discover their passions, broaden their horizons, and emerge as empowered individuals who make a positive impact on the world. I am excited about the journey ahead and the endless possibilities it holds for our students and our institution. I invite you to explore our website to learn more about the activities, faculty, facilities, and vibrant community that make up the Genius Group of Institutions.

name: Shree Mahavir Jain Charitra Kalyan Ratnashram
description: About Us The founders of the institution — the fearless and enlightened Muniraj Shri Charitra Vijayji Bapa, a renowned astrologer, orator, and musician, and the revolutionary Muniraj Shri Kalyanchandraji Bapa, a distinguished physician and lover of literature — dedicated their entire luminous lives to the growth and upliftment of this sacred place. The land also carries within its soil the essence of Muniraj Shri Gulabchandraji Bapa, an expert in music, Sanskrit, poetry, and literature, and a strict disciplinarian, along with the humble, serene, and service-oriented Muniraj Shri Uttamchandraji Bapa. The revered poet Duleray Karani, the "Bhishmapitamah" of Kutchi literature, spent 25 invaluable years here, creating immortal works of literature and imparting deep cultural values to the students. Even the Father of the Nation, Mahatma Gandhi, sanctified this place with his holy footsteps and unveiled the statue of Mother India. Royal patrons such as Maharaja Krishnakumarsinhji of Bhavnagar, the Jam Saheb of Jamnagar, Maharaja Bahadursinhji of Palitana, Himatsinhji of Kutch, and many other kings and rulers of Saurashtra and Kutch visited this sacred land time and again as devoted disciples of Pujya Bapa. Eminent Acharyas like Acharya Bhagwant Shri Vijayarāmchandra Sūrishwarji Maharaj Saheb, Acharya Shri Gunasagar Sūrishwarji Maharaj Saheb, and countless monks and nuns from different Jain traditions — Tapāgaccha, Achalgaccha, Sthānakvāsi, and others — have blessed this land with their continuous presence. This holy land has also witnessed the presence of great poets like Nanalal and Zaverchand Meghani, as well as eminent scholars and literary figures like Manubhai Pancholi and Pandit Sukhlalji, who engaged in profound literary discussions with Pujya Bapa. Thus, this pilgrimage-like institution, after passing through many trials and triumphs, has now completed 99 glorious years.

description: About Us BAPS Swaminarayan Vidyamandir, Raysan, is a Day & Residential Boys English Medium School providing comprehensive education from nursery to class XII (Science, Commerce & Arts streams). The school is situated off the Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar Highway. In the vicinity of the school, state government has also developed many educational institutes. It was inaugurated on 28 June 2006 by Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Honourable Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri Narendra Modi. The entire school campus is engulfed in a peaceful environment with an abundance of trees, shrubs and other natural features. Its purpose-built, distinctively designed buildings and infrastructure fulfils the needs for various age groups: pre-primary, primary, secondary and higher secondary. The school also has well-equipped labs, computer rooms, drawing rooms and an innovative ATL lab which caters to the need of today’s students to make them more creative. The school is affiliated to the Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board and is also planning to affiliate with the CBSE. Students are not only imparted holistic education blended with cultural values, but are also groomed to develop self-awareness, become independent scholars and thereby realize their own potential to succeed amid an increasingly competitive world. Each child acquires knowledge and skills which will aid the development of his full potential. Each student receives personal attention and motivation to help him to be confident as well as positive, have high moral values, and contribute to his family, the school and the community in an exemplary fashion. For each child’s physical, mental and talent development, various extra-curricular activities such as indoor and outdoor games, music, yoga, art and craft, etc. are organized in school by experienced coaches. Seminars by learned and experienced saints help in their spiritual and moral development. Students have achieved outstanding results in national level sports competitions and have also won awards in elocution, art, quiz and debate competitions held at state level.
